description: This file defines utility functions for resolving directory paths related to task state and registry in an OpenClaw project. It handles environment variables and constructs paths for storing task states and registry data, including SQLite database paths.

methods.name: export function resolveTaskStateDir(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): string { resolveTaskStateDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for task state data, based on environment variables. Uses a temporary directory for testing environments.

methods.name: export function resolveTaskRegistryDir(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): string { resolveTaskRegistryDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for the task registry by appending 'tasks' to the task state directory.

methods.name: export function resolveTaskRegistrySqlitePath(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): string { resolveTaskRegistrySqlitePath
methods.description: Provides the full file path to the SQLite database used for task registry data in the current environment.
